display.purpose: h1 / report titles — Source Serif 4, editorial only.

title.purpose: h3 and below — Inter takes over from the serif.

mono.purpose: Every number, ID, status, score, step — JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Light overlays; the hover ceiling (no lift).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action: deep-teal spot fill, white text. The one place teal is a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:none; border-radius:var(--radius-md,6px); background:var(--color-accent,#1b5c5e); color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-accent-hover,#154a4c); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-paper,#faf9f7),0 0 0 4px var(--color-accent,#1b5c5e); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent fill, hairline border, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid var(--color-line,#ddd9d0); border-radius:var(--radius-md,6px); background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink,#2d2a26); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--color-surface-muted,#f4f2ee); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#1b5c5e); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Field on surface white; hairline border, teal focus, ink-faint placeholder.
components.css: .ds-input { display:block; box-sizing:border-box; height:40px; width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--color-line,#ddd9d0); border-radius:var(--radius-md,6px); background:var(--color-surface,#fff); color:var(--color-ink,#2d2a26); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; transition:border-color 120ms,box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--color-ink-faint,#6f6961); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--color-accent,#1b5c5e); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-paper,#faf9f7),0 0 0 4px var(--color-accent,#1b5c5e); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Container: surface white on paper, hairline border, no shadow. Interactive variant darkens its border on hover — never a shadow lift.
components.html:
Accessibility

12 issues across 4 rules.
components.css: .ds-panel { border:1px solid var(--color-line,#ddd9d0); border-radius:var(--radius-md,6px); background:var(--color-surface,#fff); padding:24px; transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-panel--interactive:hover { border-color:rgba(45,42,38,0.2); } .ds-panel__title { margin:0 0 4px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.005em; color:var(--color-ink,#2d2a26); } .ds-panel__body { margin:0; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; color:var(--color-ink-muted,#5c5751); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped filter. Active state fills with ink (not teal — teal stays the spot colour).
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 12px; margin-right:6px; border:1px solid var(--color-line,#ddd9d0); border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-surface,#fff); color:var(--color-ink-muted,#5c5751); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms,color 120ms; } .ds-chip:hover { background:var(--color-surface-muted,#f4f2ee); border-color:rgba(45,42,38,0.2); color:var(--color-ink,#2d2a26); } .ds-chip--active { border-color:var(--color-ink,#2d2a26); background:var(--color-ink,#2d2a26); color:var(--color-surface,#fff); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-paper,#faf9f7),0 0 0 4px var(--color-accent,#1b5c5e); }

components.name: Step Number
components.description: Signature mono step marker for the numbered scan-config flow. The clearest expression of the Mono-for-Data rule.
components.css: .ds-step-num { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:24px; width:24px; border:1px solid var(--color-line,#ddd9d0); border-radius:var(--radius-md,6px); background:var(--color-surface,#fff); color:var(--color-ink-faint,#6f6961); font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: StageFlow looks like a print shop's proof sheet: serif headlines set in warm ink, monospace data ruled into tables, hairline borders instead of boxes, and the calm of paper rather than the glow of a screen. It is a tool that reports on a frontend, so the interface itself behaves like a trustworthy document: exact, legible, and never raising its voice. Depth comes from borders, not shadows; emphasis from weight and a single spot colour, not from saturation or motion. The one chromatic note is a deep teal, used the way a printer drops a single Pantone spot onto an otherwise black-on-cream page — rarely, and to mean something. This system rejects the generic SaaS-dashboard look: no cream-tinted template gradients, no icon-card grids, no alarmist red-everywhere security aesthetic, no cool-slate dark mode, no fake browser chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces (#faf9f7), warm near-black ink (#2d2a26), one deep-teal spot.
Editorial serif display (Source Serif 4) + humanist sans body (Inter) + mono data (JetBrains Mono).
Hairline borders and data tables over cards and icon grids.
Severity is always hue plus label/shape — never colour alone.

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: The deep teal is a spot colour, not a theme colour. It carries links, primary actions, and a single emphasis per region. If teal covers more than ~10% of a view, it has stopped meaning 'here.'

rules.name: The Severity-Is-Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every severity hue is paired with a text label, icon, or shape. A colour-blind reader must never have to distinguish critical from minor by hue.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Numbers, IDs, statuses, scores, and step counts are always JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums. Quantitative truth must be visually distinct from prose.

rules.name: The Serif Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 is for h1/h2 (and .font-display) only. h3 and below is Inter. Never set body or UI labels in the serif.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Blur Rule
rules.body: Interactive surfaces signal hover by darkening their border (.hover-glow), never by lifting with a shadow or translateY.

dos: Do keep surfaces warm: paper #faf9f7, ink #2d2a26. Carry warmth in paper and ink, not decoration.
Do separate with hairline #ddd9d0 borders and tonal steps; reach for a data table before an icon-card grid.
Do set every number, ID, status, score, and step in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.
Do keep the deep teal a spot colour (≤10% of any view).
Do pair every severity hue with a label, icon, or shape (colour-blind safe).
Do signal hover by darkening the border, and give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Do keep --color-ink-faint ≥ 4.5:1 and decorative --color-ink-ghost ≥ 3:1 on paper.
donts: Don't introduce a cream/sand SaaS-template background, gradient hero-metric cards, or identical icon-card grids.
Don't use an alarmist security aesthetic — no red-everywhere, no 'THREATS DETECTED' urgency, no gamified scores or confetti.
Don't add slate-* or any cool-grey, and don't ship a dark mode (the scan terminal and automation panel are the only sanctioned dark islands).
Don't lift surfaces with drop shadows or translateY on hover; elevation is borders.
Don't exceed 8px radius, set body/labels in the serif, or let teal become a dominant fill.
Don't add fake browser chrome or brand-coloured scanner logos as decoration.
Don't redefine tokens anywhere but clients/web/src/app.css.
